214.text: Curious, you enter the impenetrable swamp areas. Although the ground feels dangerously soft and slippery, you continue on your way undeterred - until you finally have to admit that you've completely lost your way again! Angry, you punch your way through the dense, damp vegetation, hoping that you'll stumble upon some landmark that might help you orient yourself a little, but somehow you just seem to be walking in circles! After some time, the saving thought finally comes to you: Instead of wandering around aimlessly, you decide to stubbornly continue your way straight ahead. Eventually you will come to a shore of the island from where you can make your way to the landing place of your boat! So you set off with renewed courage, until you finally reach a small clearing from which you can already see the southern shore of the island to the south-east, where this strange sign stood, the meaning of which you did not understand. "Phew, done!", you think to yourself relieved and want to squat down exhausted to catch your breath when you realize to your shock that you are already knee-deep in the ground. Panic-stricken, you kick your legs like crazy, but without even moving a single centimeter off the ground - on the contrary: you only sink deeper! Well, like every real adventure, "Soul Crystal" also has a quicksand location: Now you know it! So, as you slowly begin your destiny as a bog corpse, for your comfort you at least feel your foot stumbling against the remains of another unfortunate adventurer who seems to have chosen the same route as you...

220.text: As you walk across the moor on a more imaginary than actual path that runs south-west, your feet sink deeper and deeper into the spongy-soft ground. The impenetrable, damp fog that rises on both sides of your path, thickens into grotesque mythical creatures, the sight of which sends chills down your spine... A short time later, however, you tell yourself that everything that happens around you is just is a product of your overwrought nerves - pipe dreams that only grow from your fertile imagination. To give you a little encouragement, you think back to your previous adventures in this world, and that there's a little more to scaring Dave Parker than just a few ridiculous wisps of fog and a spooky background noise. You are just about to continue on your way with renewed courage when you hear a strange bubbling sound in front of you that seems to be getting closer and closer - a sound that is anything but unreal! You look around frantically, but nowhere in the middle of the waving sea of fog can you find an explanation for these eerie noises that seem to come straight from the deepest depths of the moor...

225.text: After a few meters you stop and listen again to the deceptive silence: No, it wasn't really your imagination - there are actually noises that stand out unpleasantly from the constant bubbling of the moorland! Footsteps are approaching you from behind, getting louder and louder - slowly but unstoppably... Startled, you whirl around, but can see nothing but dense, wafting wafts of fog, which twist into grotesque grimaces mocking you for your fear... Suddenly however, the ground next to you begins to seethe and bubble as if it were boiling - and then the horribly disfigured face of a half-decomposed corpse emerges from the depths! Frozen in horror and unable to take your eyes off the horrific spectacle, you watch as a zombie rises from the depths of the bog! The moment you regain control of yourself, its clawed claws will shoot for your throat! You don't know how, but somehow you throw yourself to the side again with all your strength and thus avoid certain death! However, you stumble during your parade and land hard in the mud! Now the Blackblood seems to have finally won: while you are struggling to get back on your feet, he hisses and hisses at you: as he staggers towards you, his jaws open and close with a creaking sound, exposing his disgustingly -brown tooth stumps...

Nonetheless, the zombie is delighted to make your acquaintance, as it hasn't had fresh meat for weeks - and only eating "canned adventurers" that have sunk into the swamp is, in the long run, even for a half-rotted zombie stomach a somewhat one-sided and unhealthy diet!
